title: Pesticide applicator private applicator certification practice questions
description: Practice questions on EPA private applicator certification: general standards, predator control, fumigation, aerial, age and training (40 CFR 171.105).

questions.question: Which of these persons does 171.105(i) exclude from the private applicator certification requirements in 171.105(a) through (h)?

options.A: A farmer who applies restricted use pesticides only to crops on rented land
options.B: A person conducting laboratory research involving restricted use pesticides
options.C: A private applicator who applies restricted use pesticides only by aircraft
options.D: A rancher who applies restricted use pesticides only to livestock he or she owns

questions.explanation: 171.105(i): "The requirements in § 171.105(a)-(h) of this part do not apply to the following persons: (1) Persons conducting laboratory research involving restricted use pesticides." The other listed exception is for Doctors of Medicine and Doctors of Veterinary Medicine treating patients.

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A farmer holds only general private applicator certification and wants to buy a restricted use pesticide to fumigate soil. What does 171.105(a) say about general certification alone?

options.A: It covers soil fumigation but not non-soil fumigation
options.B: It covers purchase but not use of fumigants
options.C: It covers fumigation if the farmer is at least 18 years old
options.D: It is not sufficient to authorize the purchase, use, or supervision of use of products in the categories in (b) through (f)

questions.explanation: "Certification in this general private applicator certification category alone is not sufficient to authorize the purchase, use, or supervision of use of the restricted use pesticide products in the categories listed in paragraphs (b) through (f) of this section." Soil fumigation is paragraph (d).

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.105(a), what must persons seeking certification as private applicators demonstrate?

options.A: Practical knowledge of the principles and practices of pest control associated with the production of agricultural commodities and effective use of restricted use pesticides
options.B: At least two years of experience farming
options.C: Ownership of the land on which the pesticides will be used
options.D: A degree in agriculture from an accredited college

questions.explanation: "Persons seeking certification as private applicators must demonstrate practical knowledge of the principles and practices of pest control associated with the production of agricultural commodities and effective use of restricted use pesticides."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under the laws and regulations standard in 171.105(a)(8), private applicators must have knowledge of all applicable laws and regulations of which governments?

options.A: Federal only
options.B: State only
options.C: State, Tribal, and Federal
options.D: County and municipal only

questions.explanation: The standard requires "Knowledge of all applicable State, Tribal, and Federal laws and regulations."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.105(a), when must a person be certified by an appropriate certifying authority?

options.A: Within 30 days after first using a restricted use pesticide
options.B: Before purchasing a restricted use pesticide, but not before supervising its use
options.C: Only before applying a restricted use pesticide on land the person does not own
options.D: Before using or supervising the use of a restricted use pesticide as a private applicator

questions.explanation: "Before using or supervising the use of a restricted use pesticide as a private applicator, a person must be certified by an appropriate certifying authority."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.105(a), the necessary competency to use restricted use pesticides for pest control in the production of agricultural commodities includes which ability?

options.A: The ability to read and understand pesticide labeling
options.B: The ability to write pesticide labeling for new products
options.C: The ability to run a pesticide sales business
options.D: The ability to register pesticides with EPA

questions.explanation: The necessary competency is one "which includes the ability to read and understand pesticide labeling."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 171.105(a)(1)(ix), which difference in labeling language must a private applicator recognize and understand?

options.A: The difference between English and Spanish labeling
options.B: The difference between Federal and State labeling
options.C: The difference between mandatory and advisory labeling language
options.D: The difference between registered and pending labeling

questions.explanation: The standard covers "Recognizing and understanding the difference between mandatory and advisory labeling language."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A private applicator will use sodium cyanide in a mechanical ejection device. Under 171.105(b), the applicator must demonstrate comprehension of the restrictions on the use of sodium cyanide products ordered by whom?

options.A: The county agricultural commissioner
options.B: The EPA Administrator
options.C: The device manufacturer
options.D: The State veterinarian

questions.explanation: Applicators must demonstrate comprehension of all applicable laws and regulations, "including the restrictions on the use of sodium cyanide products ordered by the EPA Administrator."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A private applicator will supervise the use of a restricted use pesticide to fumigate a site other than soil. Which standards in 171.105 must the applicator meet?

options.A: The aerial pest control standards
options.B: The sodium fluoroacetate predator control standards
options.C: No additional standards, because the applicator only supervises
options.D: The non-soil fumigation standards in 171.105(e), in addition to the general standards in 171.105(a)

questions.explanation: "In addition to satisfying the requirements in paragraph (a) of this section, private applicators that use or supervise the use of a restricted use pesticide to fumigate anything other than soil must demonstrate practical knowledge" of non-soil fumigation.

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: Under 171.105(h), who must establish the competency of each candidate for private applicator certification?

options.A: The candidate's agricultural employer
options.B: The certifying authority
options.C: The pesticide dealer that sells the restricted use pesticide
options.D: A certified commercial applicator chosen by the candidate

questions.explanation: "The competency of each candidate for private applicator certification must be established by the certifying authority."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A private applicator seeks certification to use sodium fluoroacetate livestock protection collars. Under 171.105(c), the applicator must demonstrate practical knowledge and understanding of the requirements for disposal of what?

options.A: Damaged or used sodium cyanide capsules
options.B: Empty fumigant cylinders
options.C: Punctured or leaking collars, and contaminated animal remains, vegetation, soil, and clothing
options.D: Unused treated seeds

questions.explanation: 171.105(c) lists specific requirements for "proper storage of collars, disposal of punctured or leaking collars, disposal of contaminated animal remains, vegetation, soil, and clothing". Sodium cyanide capsules belong to the sodium cyanide standards in 171.105(b).

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A private applicator certified in soil fumigation will have noncertified applicators help with a soil fumigant application under direct supervision. Under 171.105(d)(1)(ii), the labeling knowledge the applicator must demonstrate includes requirements for what?

options.A: The safety information that certified applicators must provide to noncertified applicators using fumigants under their direct supervision
options.B: Hiring noncertified applicators only through a licensed labor contractor
options.C: Registering each noncertified applicator with EPA before the application
options.D: Giving each noncertified applicator a written examination before the application

questions.explanation: 171.105(d)(1)(ii) covers "Requirements for certified applicators of fumigants, fumigant handlers and permitted fumigant handler activities, and the safety information that certified applicators must provide to noncertified applicators using fumigants under the direct supervision of certified applicators."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: Under 171.105(h)(2)(ii)(A), what must the training program for general private applicator certification cover?

options.A: Only the minimum age requirement in 171.105(g)
options.B: Only the category standards the candidate selects
options.C: Only the label and labeling comprehension standards in 171.105(a)(1)
options.D: The competency standards in 171.105(a), in sufficient detail to allow the private applicator to demonstrate practical knowledge of the principles and practices of pest control and proper and effective use of restricted use pesticides

questions.explanation: "The training program for general private applicator certification must cover the competency standards outlined in paragraph (a) of this section in sufficient detail to allow the private applicator to demonstrate practical knowledge."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: A candidate is to be certified as a private applicator in general and in aerial pest control. Under 171.105(h), the examination or training process must assure the candidate's competency in which standards?

options.A: The aerial pest control standards only, in lieu of the general standards
options.B: The general standards in 171.105(a) and the specific standards for aerial pest control
options.C: The general standards only
options.D: The standards for every category in 171.105(b) through (f), whether or not the candidate is to be certified in them

questions.explanation: The process must assure competency "in regard to the general certification standards applicable to all private applicators outlined in paragraph (a) of this section, and, if applicable, the specific standards for the each of the categories outlined in paragraphs (b) through (f) of this section in which a private applicator is to be certified."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 171.105(f) applies to private applicators that use or supervise the use of restricted use pesticides applied by which aircraft?

options.A: Only fixed wing aircraft
options.B: Only rotary wing aircraft
options.C: Only aircraft owned by the applicator
options.D: Fixed or rotary wing aircraft

questions.explanation: Paragraph (f) covers "private applicators that use or supervise the use of restricted use pesticides applied by fixed or rotary wing aircraft."

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: What does 171.105(h)(2) say any candidate for certification as a private applicator may do to establish competency?

options.A: Complete a training program approved by the certifying authority
options.B: Submit a signed statement of farming experience
options.C: Work for one season under a certified commercial applicator
options.D: Present a letter from a pesticide dealer

questions.explanation: "Any candidate for certification as a private applicator may complete a training program approved by the certifying authority to establish competency."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: A certifying authority chooses to establish private applicator competency by examination. Under 171.105(h)(1), what must the examination process meet?

options.A: Only a minimum passing score set by EPA
options.B: All of the examination standards in 171.103(a)(2), the same standards that apply to commercial applicator examinations
options.C: Only the standards for oral examinations given on the candidate's farm
options.D: Whatever requirements the candidate's employer sets

questions.explanation: 171.105(h)(1): "If the certifying authority uses an examination process to determine the competency of private applicators, the examination process must meet all of the requirements of § 171.103(a)(2)."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: Under 171.105(h), which processes may the certifying authority use to assure the competency of private applicators?

options.A: A field demonstration observed by EPA staff
options.B: A signed statement by the candidate
options.C: Either a written examination process or a non-examination training process
options.D: A recommendation from a certified commercial applicator

questions.explanation: "The certifying authority must use either a written examination process as described in paragraph (h)(1) of this section or a non-examination training process as described in paragraph (h)(2) of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: A candidate is seeking private applicator certification through a non-examination training program. Under 171.105(h)(2)(i), the government-issued photo identification (or other similarly reliable identification authorized by the certifying authority) is presented as proof of what?

options.A: Identity and age
options.B: Ownership of the farm to be treated
options.C: Prior experience applying pesticides
options.D: Residence in the State

questions.explanation: Each person must present the identification "as proof of identity and age at the time of the training program to be eligible for certification."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 171.105, Standards for certification of private applicators (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Minimum age and how competency is established
questions.question: Under 171.105(h)(2)(ii)(B), how does the training program for a private applicator category relate to the general private applicator training program?

options.A: It is taken in lieu of the general training program
options.B: It is optional once the general training is complete
options.C: It must be in addition to the training program required for general private applicator certification
options.D: It replaces the general program for applicators over 18

questions.explanation: The category training program "must be in addition to the training program required for general private applicator certification."
